notes.title: Scarier, Achievements Added and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30971806/dad03cbe7c34df00d6d96dbaf5cfea490ad79b00.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

I updated the game recently to match the console release of Emily Wants to Play Too. Here's some of what has been added.

[list]    
[*]Achievements added.
[*]Increased the the creepiness, during some of the key points and games.
[*]One of the ending cutscenes has been changed slightly.
[*]"Letting Her In" is a little more surprising.
[*]You can't get the extended cut scene, unless you find a certain secret area.
[*]Upgraded the engine.
[*]Polished a few areas.
[*]Fixed some bugs.
[*]Probably introduced some new bugs! :)
[/list]

The game was released on consoles if you are interested and the next Steam update should include VR support. Sorry the VR support is taking so long.

I have been getting great feedback about the game. Thank you very much to everyone who has played, watched and shared Emily Wants to Play Too!

Shawn

notes.title: How fast can you win Emily Wants to Play Too?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30971806/22b9ff097d1b8aefbb88caa0a50414416a3268c8.jpg[/img]

The newest update adds a speed run feature.

Look over to the right side, in the menu room on the desk. There is a speed run option. Interacting with it starts the game from the beginning and starts a timer. If you finish the entire game in one run, it will record your time.

[list]
     [*]Your fastest score is stored each time.
     [*]It's ok to lose, just click retry and the timer will pick up where it left off.
     [*]The timer is paused when you pause the game.
[/list] 

I may add achievements including one where you have to beat the developer's time. I will look into leaderboards as well.

Also, virtual reality (VR) is still in the works for HTC Vive and Oculus.
 
Thanks for playing Emily Wants to Play Too!
